classdef.name: RubyParentSpacing
classdef.shortdesc: Options for ruby spacing relative to the parent text.

property.name: RUBY_PARENT_NO_ADJUSTMENT
property.shortdesc: Does not base ruby spacing on parent text.

property.name: RUBY_PARENT_EQUAL_AKI
property.shortdesc: Applies the parent text aki to the ruby characters.

property.name: RUBY_PARENT_FULL_JUSTIFY
property.shortdesc: Justifies ruby characters to both edges of the parent text.
